text:
maria_cs: FYI onboarding hit for account acct-501. Customer reports repeated 429 spikes during initial SDK prefetch, followed by auth failures. Looks like a token relay loop between their refresh endpoint and our preflight.
ajay_se: can you paste the short logs? samples are most helpful.
ops-bot: Alert: rate_limit burst detected for acct-501 (10m window) :rotating_light:
maria_cs: pasted minimal log snippet from customer (redacted):
```
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] prefetch: /v1/prefetch start
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] auth: got ephemeral token ttl=30s exp=2026-03-19T14:01:32Z
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] sdk: cached token and fired request
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] refresh: client called /refresh -> issued new token exp=2026-03-19T14:01:35Z
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] sdk: saw token mismatch, re-fetched token -> duplicate preflight
[2026-03-19T14:01:02Z] gateway: 429 rate_limit preflight concurrent=6
```
maria_cs: they also showed header dump where both `Authorization` and `X-Client-Token` are sent by their wrapper, so server sees two tokens and our preflight TTL check treats it as different identity.
ajay_se: ugh — two tokens + tiny TTL + concurrent prefetches = stampede. Not purely clock drift.
nina_sdk: mitigation options: (1) SDK-side dedupe lock for in-flight token refresh per client id, (2) add leeway to token validity check (e.g., treat tokens expiring <5s as expired) and jitter refresh, (3) server-side accept single token header priority and return idempotent response + Retry-After.
ajay_se: agreed. Quick patch we can ship: add per-process in-flight refresh promise map keyed by client_hw_id and a 200ms random jitter before triggering refresh. I'll draft PR.
harry_infra: also can make temporary quota exception for acct-501 to avoid user-facing 429 while they patch. We can raise concurrent preflight limit from 5->20 for 24h on that tenant. Need CS sign-off.
maria_cs: please do — customer already on a tight deadline for pilot. I'll request the quota bump. @harry_infra do you need a ticket?
harry_infra: ticket appreciated. set tenant id acct-501 in summary and tag ops. I'll schedule the bump after approval.
maria_cs: created ticket INF-7421 and linked logs.
ajay_se: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/812 — includes in-flight lock + 250ms jitter and a TTL-leeway config flag. Can we backport to 2.x SDK?
nina_sdk: yes, will backport to 2.x patch branch. Recommend adding opt-in config flag so older clients can toggle.
maria_cs: plan: (1) infra quota bump (harry) (2) SDK patch + release candidate (ajay/nina) (3) CS coordinate customer rollout and observe metrics for 6h. I'll own customer comms.
ops-bot: Note: temporary quota changes will emit billing/usage events.
maria_cs: thanks — will update customer. tagging owners: @ajay_se (sdk PR), @nina_sdk (backport), @harry_infra (quota), maria_cs (CS owner). :white_check_mark:
ajay_se: small follow up — recommend adding server-side header priority in our gateway: if both `Authorization` and `X-Client-Token` present, prefer `Authorization` and log duplicate for 7d to help customers find wrappers adding extra headers. I'll open infra RFC.
harry_infra: ack. I'll coordinate with gateway team.
maria_cs: closing loop here once quota is bumped and SDK RC released. will post follow-up metrics thread. Thanks all!
